    # Fractional damping
    fractional_damping = params[0]
    damping_coef = params[1] * (1 - fractional_damping) if 0 < fractional_damping < 1 else params[1]
    
    # Linear damping coefficient, represented by 'params[2]'
    b = params[2]

    k = params[3]
